name: material_pass_authoring
description: G-1: Add material pass... on the Frame Plan adds a forward_opaque pass to a project with a model, Create missing targets makes scene_color and scene_depth in the same Save, and once present reads scene_color the model is on screen. G-4: the pipeline has no pass for deferred materials, so the form offers the forward default, checked; Save carries it with the pass and Studio restarts the engine on the same project.
